payload.title: Root Application component id changes with the scan folder name
payload.description: Without a configured project name, the scanner names the root Application component after the scanned folder (deterministic-scan.ts projectNameFromPath), and the name is part of its stable key, so the same commit scanned in two folders gives that component two ids (Jira DATAP-858). Expected: the key does not depend on the folder name; the display name may still be the folder name.
